messages:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered: auth-rate-checker -> P1. Spike of 401s to /auth/session from IP range 203.0.113.0/24. Alert window: 02:12-02:17 UTC. See live logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/abcd1234

alice (oncall): I'm on it. Any customer reports?

ben (sre): No broad user-facing 401 spike on prod-api. Majority of failures are svcacct token validations from model-cache-worker pool. Spike started ~02:12 UTC.

carol (sec): IP behavior looks like credential stuffing / token probe. Suggest blocking at edge + rotating affected service account keys. I'll prepare rotation ticket and legal notification if we confirm exfil.

dana (support): Two customers reported slow responses around 02:15, but they did not see auth errors. I'll keep them updated.

alice (oncall): Edge ACL applied: blocking 203.0.113.0/24 at WAF. Doing now.

incidents-bot: waf-rule-add 203.0.113.0/24 -> success (:white_check_mark:) — rule id wr-2026-77

ben (sre): After ACL, inbound auth validation attempts from that range dropped to zero. Still seeing ~30 failed svcacct validations with identical token signature. Listing impacted tokens to rotate.

carol (sec): Confirming recommendation: rotate keys for svcacct 'model-cache-worker' and revoke old KMS material. Impact: rolling restarts (~2 pods per AZ). Approve emergency rotation.

alice (oncall): Plan: 1) block (done). 2) rotate model-cache-worker svcacct keys (immediate). 3) monitor customer-facing error rates. 4) notify Legal/Compliance and Support for customer comms. @dana escalate if customers ask for details.

eric (eng): Starting rotation sequence. Commands:
```
./ops/rotate_svc_keys --service model-cache-worker --env prod --commit
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-cache-worker -n infra
```
ETA ~6 minutes for full rollout. I'll kick off now.

alice (oncall): Go for it. Starting rotation at 02:18 UTC. Notifying next shift if still open.

incidents-bot: Key rotation job initiated by eric at 02:18 UTC. Jobs: pods restarting 2/12.

ben (sre): 12/12 pods restarted. Readiness checks passing. Auth error rate for model-cache-worker back to baseline. No new traffic from 203.0.113.0/24.

carol (sec): Rotation + ACL successful. I'm scheduling KMS key disable in 1 hour as a safety step. Will create INC ticket for follow-ups and attach IoCs.

dana (support): Support channel update sent: "Mitigation applied, no auth failures observed for customers. We're monitoring and will follow up if anything changes"

alice (oncall): Triage summary for handoff: suspected credential-stuffing probe from external IP range targeting /auth/session; edge block applied; rotated model-cache-worker svcacct keys; KMS disable scheduled; no confirmed customer auth failures; monitoring window 24h. Handoff to @frank for vigilance on WAF/auth dashboards (0800-1600 UTC).

frank (sre-oncall): ack taking over. I'll monitor auth rates, WAF hits, and token validation metrics every 5m.

carol (sec): Follow-ups assigned: INC-2026-042 (KMS disable + log export), coordinate with Legal/Compliance for potential disclosure, and run indicator search for similar token signatures across 7-day window.

alice (oncall): Closing Slack bridge for now. If any regression, ping @pager immediately. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
